# Copenhagen – Must-See Highlights

## Iconic Landmarks
- **Nyhavn** – The colorful harbor-front canal, perfect for photos and a stroll
- **The Little Mermaid** – The famous statue on the waterfront (manage expectations – it's small!)
- **Christiansborg Palace** – Houses parliament; climb the tower for free panoramic views
- **Rosenborg Castle** – Renaissance castle with the Crown Jewels

## Neighborhoods & Culture
- **Christiania (Freetown)** – The famous alternative/counterculture community
- **Tivoli Gardens** – Historic amusement park and gardens (especially magical in the evening)
- **Strøget** – One of Europe's longest pedestrian shopping streets
- **Torvehallerne** – Covered food market, great for Danish specialties

## Museums
- **National Museum of Denmark** – Danish history from Viking age onward
- **Louisiana Museum of Modern Art** – Stunning art + architecture on the coast (short train ride north)
- **Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek** – Beautiful art museum with a winter garden
- **Designmuseum Danmark** – If you love Scandinavian design

## Food to Try
- **Smørrebrød** (open-faced sandwiches)
- **Danish pastries** (wienerbrød)
- **Hot dogs** from a pølsevogn (street cart)

## Tips
- Rent a **bike** – the city is very cycle-friendly
- Get a **Copenhagen Card** if you plan to visit many museums (includes transit)
- The city is very walkable and compact

How many days will you be there? I can help you plan a rough itinerary!
